content:
If you're still looking to pick up the AirPods Pro 3, Amazon's 25%-off deal is still going strong, but today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break has to kick off with another opportunity — a $100 price drop on the entire AirPods Max 2 lineup, plus $300 off this 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro. Also, Anker's brand-new Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe car charger mount is 25% off; Best Buy's back-to-school sale is still running with tons of deals on electronics, dorm gear, smart home, and more. Head below for the full rundown.

Amazon's nearly 25%-off AirPods Pro 3 deal is still live and could go back up in price at any time

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (with Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (original price $179, brand new) – Renewed Premium

Last week's Apple shopping event brought one of the best deals we've seen since the AirPods Pro 3 launched. That Best Buy promotion — and its Pro 3 discount — has since ended, and Best Buy has moved on to its 2026 Black to School sale; but Amazon's nearly 25% AirPods Pro 3 discount is still live… for now.

Amazon is still selling Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 for $189.99 with free shipping.

The product has a $249 MSRP — this is essentially a 25% discount, about $10 better than July's 'Black Friday' deals, and one of the lowest prices we've tracked since launch.

Act fast! Apple refurb M5 MacBook Pro is back in stock at $1,439

Update: Apple's official refurbished store now has the Space Black 512GB M5 MacBook Pro back in stock, priced the same at $1,439 — this deal will very likely be gone soon.

Apple's official refurbished store currently has the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 512GB back in stock, selling for $1,439. For those looking to grab a current-generation model at a discount, this is a very rare opportunity — Apple's MSRP for the cheapest MacBook Pro as a brand-new unit is $1,999.

Apple is now selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro in silver with 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD for $1,439 with free shipping. This deal likely won't last long — the Space Black model sold out within a matter of hours.

When Apple launched the latest M5 Pro and M5 Max models earlier this year, it dropped the 512GB storage option on the M5, effectively raising the entry price for the entire lineup. Combined with subsequent price hikes, the starting price has now reached $1,999.

Apple's official refurbished store offers the cheapest M5 MacBook Pro with $300 off

The cheapest tier of M5 series deals has generally been hard to come by. However, Apple's official refurbished store is offering an attractive deal on the cheapest M5 MacBook Pro still available — the 16GB/1TB configuration is $300 off its original price.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is currently selling the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB RAM and 1TB SSD for $1,699 with free shipping.

Amazon Apple Watch Ultra 3 this configuration is currently nearly $130 off

Over the past week — and through the Apple shopping event last weekend — we've spotted quite a few deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 lineup. But this particular configuration with nearly $130 off is the most attractive, and Amazon is back at it again.

Amazon is now selling the Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue/Vivid Blue Trail Loop for $669.97 with free shipping.

This configuration has an MSRP of $799, and today it's $129 off again — the same deal we spotted late last week. It sold out completely back then, and today it's back in force.

Over the past year or so, deals on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have appeared from time to time, but they generally don't go below $99. Best Buy offered $49 off various configurations in its recent promotion, but this special deal on the Natural Titanium model is far better by comparison.

Aside from the Prime Day discount and the brief 'bounce-back' deals that followed, this is the lowest price we've tracked to date — within just $20 of the limited-time Prime Day deal, and very likely won't last long.

  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $670 (original price $799)
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $799 (original price $899)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (original price $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (original price $429)

Anker's latest Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe car charger mount up to 25% off on Amazon

As part of the ongoing Anker back-to-school sale we covered yesterday, and with Anker's 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand also returning to its Prime Day low, we're now seeing the brand's newest Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe car charger mount drop to under $67.

Anker's official Amazon store is currently selling the Prime Qi2 25W MagSafe-compatible wireless car charger mount for $67.49 with free shipping.

This product is part of Anker's late-2025 Prime charging lineup, bringing the brand's latest and greatest 25W smartphone fast charging to your car. Priced at $90, it's currently 25% off — and even lower than the $70 price point we tracked during the July summer sale.

It features a sleek black exterior with silver trim, a subtle blue light underneath the MagSafe charging pad, built-in Qi2 25W wireless charging, and aviation-grade TEC-based AirCool cooling technology to keep your device at an optimal temperature while driving. Anker says this combination can get 'your iPhone 17 Pro to 50% in 22 minutes.'

The mount supports multi-angle adjustment and works in both portrait and landscape orientations. The package includes the mount itself, Anker's car adapter, a 3.3ft USB-C cable, a cable organizer, and a few mounting clips to help keep your cabin tidy.

Anker's latest 3-in-1 Qi2 25W foldable MagSafe charging stand returns to Prime Day low (35% off)

Best Buy updates 2026 back-to-school sale: sub-$500 TVs, $130 off Bose, Apple gear, Ninja kitchen, and tons more deals

All colors of AirPods Max 2 get $100 off during Apple's 4-day limited-time deal this week

While Amazon further dropped the AirPods Pro 3 price during its ongoing weekend Apple event, the $100 discount on Apple's latest AirPods Max 2 is still live.

Amazon is now selling all five colors of Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2 over-ear headphones for $449 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $549, it's currently $100 off — the lowest price we've found.

This weekend's deals are a continuation of 'Black Friday' and July promotions. While certain colors briefly ticked up in price earlier, all of them are back to $100 off now.

The only time Apple's new-generation AirPods Max 2 sold for less than today's price was during Prime Day at the end of June — otherwise, this is the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon since it launched earlier this year.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Spigen Mini MagSafe iPhone pouch/EDC organizer drops to $27
  • Amazon rarely discounts Apple Sport Bands and Loops by 20% this week
  • Matte Black Beats Solo Buds down to as low as $41
  • Anker 5-port Nano travel adapter, claimed to work in 'over 200 countries,' drops to $20
  • David Pogue's book 'Apple: The First 50 Years' hardcover down to $26 on Amazon (original price $50)
  • Latest Beats 240W braided USB-C cable (Black) returns to Prime Day low of $18 with free shipping (40% off)
  • Store your Apple Watch bands elegantly: Twelve South TimePorter drops to under $23
  • UGREEN 65W Nexode Air is one of the smallest chargers we've seen, nearly 50% off, now just $21.50
  • DOCKCASE SSD enclosure displays drive health and features power loss protection, now just $30 (all-time low)
  • Rare deal knocks Belkin's latest UltraCharge 2-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger down to $54 (all colors)

Anker 2026 back-to-school sale drops chargers, power banks, Qi2.2 gear to Prime Day lows starting from $10 (46% off)

Anker is currently running a back-to-school sale with the promo code SCHOOL20 for 20% off sitewide, covering chargers, power banks, cables, charging stands, and more. The brand's official Amazon store is also offering corresponding deals and stacking extra discounts on select popular models. Many of the deals on Amazon have already seen prices adjusted back to recent Prime Day historical lows, so you don't have to wait until the next major shopping event to potentially snag year-low prices. Whether you're gearing up for a new school year or a new job, or just want to swap out your charger, there are still plenty of Anker deals worth keeping an eye on.

Anker 2026 back-to-school sale is now live

The brand's official Amazon store has added a fresh batch of new deals, and we've picked out a selection to list alongside the existing deals below for your reference.

  • Anker 45W Nano charger with smart display $26 (original price $40)
  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (original price $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (original price $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch control $116 (original price $150)
  • Anker 140W 4-port laptop charger with display $65 (original price $90)
  • Anker 25,000mAh 165W laptop power bank with dual USB-C cables $105 (original price $120)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 docking station with detachable 6-in-1 hub $112 (original price $150)
  • Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charging station $72 (original price $90)
  • Anker Nano ultra-slim 5,000mAh MagSafe power bank $44 (original price $55)
  • Promo code: SCHOOL20
  • And more…

Get a $25 Best Buy gift card with MacBook Neo, or snag one at $120 off via Apple's official refurbished store

No matter how you look at it, MacBook Neo deals are virtually one-of-a-kind. Even though the machine got a price hike, it's still Apple's cheapest current-generation MacBook, and there are now ways to save — Best Buy is offering a $25 gift card with new units during its latest Apple shopping event; Apple's official certified refurbished store is offering up to $120 off.

Best Buy launched its 4-day Apple shopping event yesterday, and while some products are cheaper on Amazon, they're now offering the best price on brand-new MacBook Neo configurations:

  • MacBook Neo + $25 Best Buy gift card, starting from $699

If you want the cheapest MacBook Neo, you'll want to look at Apple's official certified refurbished store. While it just got a price hike, if you're looking for the cheapest way to get one, this is the place:

  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 256GB $599 (original new price $699)
  • Apple refurbished MacBook Neo 512GB with Touch ID $679 (original new price $799)

The 256GB model is essentially just back to its old MSRP, and the 512GB model is $20 less than the old price — but a price hike is a price hike, and it's not going away anytime soon.
